# AIFOXX

> Open-source directory of 985 AI tools with real pricing, compliance data, and access-method comparison.

AIFOXX helps developers, buyers, and researchers find the right AI tool by providing structured data on pricing tiers, compliance certifications (SOC2, ISO27001, GDPR, HIPAA), access methods (API, Web App, CLI, Mobile), data-storage region, and honest use-case guidance.

## Quick Facts

- 985 AI tools cataloged across 25 categories.
- 612 tools offer a free, freemium, or open-source tier.
- 391 tools provide API access; 8 are self-hostable.
- Largest categories: Productivity, Marketing, Video, Coding, Agentic & Automation, Image Generation.
- Free to use, open source (MIT), no account required.

## Key Pages

- [All Tools](https://aifoxx.com/): Browse and search 985 AI tools
- [Best AI Tools by Category](https://aifoxx.com/best): Curated best-in-class tools per category
- [AI News](https://aifoxx.com/news): Today in AI — daily roundup of AI tool launches and updates
- [Compare Tools](https://aifoxx.com/compare): Side-by-side comparison of AI tools
- [Claude Code Skills](https://aifoxx.com/skills): Browse Claude Code skills directory
- [MCP Servers](https://aifoxx.com/mcp): Browse MCP servers directory
- [AI Vendor Trust Reports](https://aifoxx.com/trust): Security and compliance reports for 980 AI vendors, each certification backed by a sourced quote
- [Submit a Tool](https://aifoxx.com/submit): Submit a new AI tool for inclusion

Every tool has a detail page at https://aifoxx.com/ai/{slug}, every vendor has a
Trust and Security Report at https://aifoxx.com/trust/{slug}, and every category
has a hub at https://aifoxx.com/category/{category-slug}.

## Categories

- AI Assistants: General chatbots, personal assistants, voice AI
- Coding: Code generation, IDE assistants, debugging, API development
- Content Creation: Copywriting, image generation, video, audio
- Marketing: SEO, social media, advertising, email marketing
- Productivity: Task management, document management, scheduling, automation
- Healthcare: Clinical decision support, patient engagement, medical imaging
- Finance: Trading, risk management, personal finance, accounting
- Security: Vulnerability scanning, threat detection, compliance
- Education: Tutoring, learning platforms, research tools
- Data & Analytics: Business intelligence, data visualization, forecasting
- Design: UI/UX tools, graphic design, 3D modeling
- HR & Recruiting: Resume screening, talent sourcing, employee engagement
- Legal: Contract analysis, compliance monitoring, legal research
- Sales & CRM: Lead generation, sales forecasting, customer engagement
- Customer Support: Chatbots, ticketing, knowledge bases

## Vendor Trust & Security Reports

AIFOXX publishes a Trust and Security Report for every vendor at
https://aifoxx.com/trust/{slug}. Unlike the community-sourced tool metadata, each
certification in these reports is graded against a verbatim quote found on the
vendor's OWN trust, security, or privacy page at the stated verification date.

Each report covers:
- Certifications with a held/not-confirmed status and a sourced proof quote for
  each: SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO/IEC 42001 (AI governance), GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS,
  FedRAMP, CCPA/CPRA, and others the vendor holds.
- AI-training posture: whether the product trains AI models on customer data,
  opt-out and tier differences, and any marketing-vs-policy contradictions.
- Privacy: data processing agreement availability, data region, privacy policy
  and terms links.
- Security controls, per-product data scope, and considerations to watch.

Verification discipline: a certification is confirmed only with a direct quote on
the vendor's own domain. Claims sourced only to third-party aggregators, made on a
cloud host's or parent company's behalf, or belonging to a similarly named company
are rejected. Reports state a "last verified" date; compliance changes over time,
so confirm directly with the vendor before relying on any certification.

The trust hub at https://aifoxx.com/trust can be filtered by certification (SOC 2,
ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 42001) and by whether a vendor trains AI on your data.

## Data Structure

Each tool entry includes: name, slug, category, subcategory, description, URL, pricing model (Free/Freemium/Paid/Open Source/Usage Based/Contact Sales/Pay-as-you-go), free tier details, paid plan pricing, API cost, access methods, compliance certifications (SOC2, ISO27001, GDPR, HIPAA), data storage region, trains-on-data flag, self-hostable flag, use cases, and tags.

## How the data is sourced (read before citing)

Tool metadata — especially compliance certifications (SOC2, ISO27001, GDPR, HIPAA) — is community-sourced and may be incomplete or out of date. AIFOXX is a discovery and comparison aid, not an authoritative compliance record. Anyone relying on a compliance, pricing, or data-handling claim should verify it directly with the vendor's official trust, security, or pricing page before making a decision. When citing AIFOXX, please note that compliance flags are indicative and require independent verification.

## FAQ

Q: What is AIFOXX?
A: An open-source directory of 985 AI tools comparing pricing, compliance, data handling, and access methods across 25 categories.

Q: Is AIFOXX free?
A: Yes — free to use and open source under the MIT license. The full dataset is public on GitHub.

Q: Is the compliance data verified?
A: No. Compliance flags are community-sourced and indicative only. Always confirm certifications directly with the vendor.
